event: 2026 ILCA 6 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: Hearing No. 8, 9,11 was heard together with hearing No. 7 in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) since all 4 hearings arose from very closely connected incidents.
ESP 227309 was represented by Fernando ECHAVARRI CASTANEDO
ESP 227522 was represented by Félix RAMOS RUSSO
Race Committee was represented by Michalis Karastamatis
Christina Pujol (coach of ESP 227309 and ESP 227522) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: Race 5 was started with the black flag
ESP 227309 was positioned near the race committee starting vessel.
ESP 227522 was positioned close to the pin end starting vessel.
At 5 seconds to the starting signal ESP 227309 was identified to be in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark.
At 2 seconds to the starting signal ESP 227522 was identified to be in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark.
Both ESP 227309 and ESP 227522 sail numbers were presented on the board on the race committee starting vessel as BFD for race 5 after the start.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
